  Issue: The regex `r'\b\w+ "\$\{attempt_prompt_file\}"'` uses a single literal space between the function name and the argument. If a future refactor formats the call site with multiple spaces or a tab (`func_name  "${attempt_prompt_file}"` or `func_name\t"${attempt_prompt_file}"`), the pattern would miss, causing a false test failure on a legitimate refactor.
  Suggested minimal fix: Change the single space to `\s+` in the call-site regex: `r'\b\w+\s+"\$\{attempt_prompt_file\}"'`. This matches any whitespace between the function name and its first argument without weakening the guard against the `EDITOR_PROMPT_FILE` regression.
